# victorops_user (Resource)

Manages a VictorOps/Splunk OnCall user. Set `replacement_user` (or the `VO_REPLACEMENT_USERNAME` env var) to a default username so the user can be deleted. Creating admin users is not supported, `is_admin` is deprecated and ignored.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "victorops_user" "jdane" {
  first_name       = "John"
  last_name        = "Dane"
  user_name        = "jdane"
  email            = "jdane@example.com"
  replacement_user = "default_user" # username that takes over this user's items on delete
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the user.
- `first_name` (String) The first name of the user.
- `last_name` (String) The last name of the user.
- `user_name` (String) The username of the user. This is immutable after creation.

### Optional

- `expiration_hours` (Number) The number of hours until the user invitation expires. Only used during creation.
- `is_admin` (Boolean, Deprecated) Whether the user is an admin. This field is deprecated and cannot be updated after creation.
- `replacement_user` (String) The username of a replacement user. Required when deleting a user.

### Read-Only

- `default_email_contact_id` (Number) The ID of the user's default email contact.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
